notes.title: Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey Out Now On Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
The Pretzel is out there! Together with developer Robot Pumpkin Games are thrilled to announce that our comedic sci-fi text adventure game Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey is out today for Nintendo Switch with a generous 34% limited time launch discount. 

Following in the footsteps of the already released PC, iOS, and Android versions, Plan B From Outer Space leverages choose-your-own-adventure-style gameplay to hilariously tell the daunting tale of a castaway alien who’s taken an unforeseen “vacation” in the Germanic South. Hop into the space boots of a shipwrecked alien shapeshifter as they experience Bavarian hospitality first-hand — or tentacle — and try to repair their ship and get the heck off the planet without being detected by the locals. With over 19 unique endings, each decision made will affect the way the story unfolds. Get immersed in the beautiful hand-drawn scenery, colorful culture, and traditional cuisine...or else rouse the locals’ suspicions. 

Check out the Nintendo Switch trailer for Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey here:
[previewyoutube=GoYHbbU39hY;full]YOUTUBE[/previewyoutube]


About Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey
Subvert the “Alien Invader” trope by taking on the persona of one. The mission? Once the crash and culture shock wears off, explore the cozy Bavarian town of Unter-Hinterobersdorf, located in the beautiful scenic Germanic countryside, and stay under the citizens’ radar while fixing your radar (and the rest of the ship while you’re at it). Design a cute and cuddly or funky fresh Martian visitor and utilize the Aliens’ shapeshifting abilities for some bonafide “Barbvarian” blending-in. With engaging minigames that progress the narrative, a charming story, and gorgeous illustrations, Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey is sure to be an unforgettable, out-of-this-world adventure.

Features of Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040560/6c62d56c2e9b043ff59a9c3cf4cf7c8a317fbe0a.png
“Basic” Bavarians Meet “Extra” Terrestrials: Design your very own cute, cuddly, and conniving space creature with unique features and a touching backstory
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040560/6c62d56c2e9b043ff59a9c3cf4cf7c8a317fbe0a.png
Make the Right (or Funniest) Decision: With 19 possible endings, every choice matters, which means plenty of trial and error with comedic results
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040560/6c62d56c2e9b043ff59a9c3cf4cf7c8a317fbe0a.png
Big Brain Blobs: Use those alien wits to solve fun, challenging mini-games and discover handy (or tentacle-y) items to help you escape the savage backwater of Southern Germany
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040560/6c62d56c2e9b043ff59a9c3cf4cf7c8a317fbe0a.png
Handmade German Craftsmanship: Dozens of beautifully illustrated backgrounds and animated characters breathe life and personality into this sci-fi comedy experience

Developed by RobotPumpkin Games and published by Assemble Entertainment, Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey is out today for Nintendo Switch.

The game is also available now here on Steam, and iOS and Android mobile devices.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683620/Plan_B_from_Outer_Space_A_Bavarian_Odyssey/

Commander!
We were just flying through space, minding our own alien-business, when – bang! – a meteor hit us right in the quoxel-bladder! Looks like we crash-landed on this strange world. So, chop chop! Use your shapeshifting powers, disguise the ship, and find a way to escape this wretched planet post-haste!

Where did we go down? How should I know? I am just a highly developed AI! My scans show we are in a strange land of beer… pretzels... and erm, BAVARIANS! Stay vigilant, stay ready and stay slimy, should the situation demand it. I have a feeling we are not prepared for what’s to come…

notes.title: Plan B From Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey, Coming October 28!
notes.content:
There’s nothing worse than your car breaking down in some backwoods, out of the way village far (really, really far) from home — especially when that car is actually a flying saucer! 

Plan B From Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey, a new interactive adventure, is headed to mobile platforms and PC here on Steam on October 28, 2021! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683620/Plan_B_from_Outer_Space_A_Bavarian_Odyssey/

In the game, players will hop into the space-boots of a shipwrecked shapeshifter as they experience Bavarian hospitality first-hand — or tentacle — and try to repair their ship and get the heck off the planet before the cockpit permanently smells of lager and pretzels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040560/d10a3e33ce9bedd265194bf96acd58d31bac4ce0.gif

About Plan B From Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey
Set in the style of an interactive book — similar to previous RobotPumpkin games like the popular The Innsmouth Case — Plan B From Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey is a classic tale of culture shock between two very different demographics. The game will see players designing their very own custom space creature who will attempt to navigate this strange, archaic land filled with lederhosen and lager where every decision can change the outcome of the story! Inspired by old-school science fiction stories and with a hefty dose of poking fun at German village life, players can look forward to beautiful, hand-drawn art, endearing characters and hilarious encounters, along with19 different endings — the tiny Bavarian town of “Unter-Hinterobersdorf” is waiting!

Check out the latest trailer here:
[previewyoutube=I0Ui-Y8XUqg;full][/previewyoutube]


Features of Plan B From Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey:
 “Basic” Bavarians Meet “Extra” Terrestrials: Design your very own cute, cuddly, and conniving space creature with unique features and a touching backstory.
 Make the Right (or Funniest) Decision: With 19 possible endings, every choice matters, which means plenty of trial and error with comedic results.
 Big Brain Blobs: Use those alien wits to solve fun, challenging mini-games and discover handy (or tentacle-y) items to help you escape the savage backwater of Southern Germany.
 Handmade German Craftsmanship: Dozens of beautifully illustrated backgrounds and animated characters breathe life and personality into this perfectly blended sci-fi comedy experience.


Developed by Robot Pumpkin Games and published by Assemble Entertainment, Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey will launch on Steam, iOS, and Android on October 28, 2021. 
Learn more and add the game to your Steam wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683620/Plan_B_from_Outer_Space_A_Bavarian_Odyssey/

notes.title: Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey revealed!
notes.content:
Together with developer RobotPumpkin Games we are pleased to announce today: 
Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey, a sci-fi adventure that pits intergalactic castaways against South-German Barbvarians — headed to Windows PC via Steam, iOS, and Android this Fall.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040560/d10a3e33ce9bedd265194bf96acd58d31bac4ce0.gif 

The title follows a similar format to Robot Pumpkin’s debut title, The Innsmouth Case, presented as an interactive novel where the player’s choices affect the outcome of the game — which means 19 different possible endings to explore! 

So pour a tall mug of Hefeweizen, throw some Weisswurst on the grill, and polish that accent to ensure the locals don’t catch on that you aren’t from the neighborhood...

Check out the Announcement-Trailer for Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey on YouTube: 
[previewyoutube=I0Ui-Y8XUqg;full][/previewyoutube]

About Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey
While taking a cruise through our solar system, a delightfully adorable extraterrestrial is struck by space debris and comes crashing down in the south of Germany. Unfortunately for them, the locals aren’t exactly up to speed on the reality of life outside of Earth, so these shapeshifting castaways must use their special abilities to blend in with these “Barbvarians” and figure out how to get off the planet, which smells strongly of hops and salted bread. Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey is an engaging, heartfelt adventure that flips the script on classic “Alien Invader” tropes!

Features of Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey 
 “Basic” Bavarians Meet “Extra” Terrestrials: Design your very own cute, cuddly, and conniving space creature with unique features and a touching backstory
 Make the Right (or Funniest) Decision: With 19 possible endings, every choice matters, which means plenty of trial and error with comedic results
 Big Brain Blobs: Use those alien wits to solve fun, challenging mini-games and discover handy (or tentacle-y) items to help you escape the savage backwater of Southern Germany
 Handmade German Craftsmanship: Dozens of beautifully illustrated backgrounds and animated characters breathe life and personality into this sci-fi comedy experience

Developed by Robot Pumpkin Games and published by Assemble Entertainment, Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey will launch on Steam, iOS, and Android this Fall.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683620/Plan_B_from_Outer_Space_A_Bavarian_Odyssey/
